import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

repo = Path('/home/liuxuedeng/Django-Agent')
review_path = repo / 'docs/refactor-evidence/20261011-document-status-review.json'
assert not review_path.exists(), 'Never overwrite evidence'
phases = {'red': 1, 'green': 0, 'projection-reset-red': 1, 'green-final': 0, 'unit': 1, 'build': 0, 'wiki-long-input-recheck': 0, 'wiki-utf8-diagnostic': 1, 'wiki-fixture-red': 1, 'wiki-fixture-green': 0, 'unit-final': 0}
sources = ['frontend/src/views/KnowledgeDetail.vue', 'frontend/src/views/KnowledgeDetail.behavior.test.mjs', 'frontend/src/views/KnowledgeDetail.polling.test.mjs', 'frontend/src/views/KnowledgeDetail.workspace-layout.test.mjs', 'frontend/src/views/Wiki.page-actions.test.mjs']
hash_file = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
source_hashes = {name: hash_file(repo / name) for name in sources}
checks = []
for phase, expected in phases.items():
    receipt_path = repo / f'docs/refactor-evidence/20261011-document-status-{phase}.json'
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    assert receipt['exit_code'] == expected, phase
    output_path = repo / receipt['output']
    output = output_path.read_text()
    stats = {name: int(value) for name, value in re.findall(r'^# (tests|pass|fail|cancelled|skipped|todo) (\d+)$', output, re.M)}
    if phase in ['green-final', 'build', 'wiki-fixture-green', 'unit-final']:
        for name, value in receipt['source_sha256'].items():
            assert source_hashes[name] == value, f'{phase} source changed: {name}'
    if phase == 'unit-final':
        assert stats['fail'] == stats['cancelled'] == stats['skipped'] == stats['todo'] == 0
        assert stats['tests'] == stats['pass'] == 326, stats
    checks.append({'phase': phase, 'receipt': str(receipt_path.relative_to(repo)), 'receipt_sha256': hash_file(receipt_path), 'output_sha256': hash_file(output_path), 'summary': stats, 'exit_code': receipt['exit_code'], 'elapsed_ms': receipt['elapsed_ms']})

doc_path = repo / 'docs/desktop-refactor/DOCUMENT-STATUS.md'
assert '- [ ] 验证文档链接/差异' in doc_path.read_text()
text = doc_path.read_text().replace('- [ ] 验证文档链接/差异', '- [x] 验证文档链接/差异')
text += '\n独立收据汇总、最终文件哈希及临时脚本清理记录见[复核记录](../refactor-evidence/20261011-document-status-review.json)。\n'
doc_path.write_text(text)
source_hashes[str(doc_path.relative_to(repo))] = hash_file(doc_path)
links = []
for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
    resolved = (doc_path.parent / target.split('#')[0]).resolve()
    assert resolved == review_path or resolved.exists(), target
    links.append(target)
diff = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', '--', *sources, str(doc_path.relative_to(repo))], cwd=repo, text=True, capture_output=True)
assert diff.returncode == 0, diff.stdout + diff.stderr

helpers = [Path('/tmp/marlin-document-status-evidence-20261011.py'), Path('/tmp/marlin-document-status-wiki-utf8-diagnostic-20261011.mjs'), Path(__file__)]
helper_records = [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': hash_file(path), 'source': path.read_text()} for path in helpers]
record = {'checked_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'source_sha256': source_hashes, 'original_wiki_fixture_sha256': 'b34544ac8801bbd650ff85a390c9e51d9e7132135d06b5a664df7a48ea73dde4', 'checks': checks, 'git_diff_check_exit_code': diff.returncode, 'document_links_checked': links, 'missing_document_links': [], 'temporary_helpers': helper_records, 'live_data_accessed': False, 'model_calls': 0, 'actual_orca_ui_tested': False}
for path, helper in zip(helpers, helper_records):
    assert hash_file(path) == helper['sha256'], path
    path.unlink()
    helper['removed'] = not path.exists()
assert all(helper['removed'] for helper in helper_records)
with review_path.open('x') as output:
    json.dump(record, output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    output.write('\n')
for target in links:
    assert (doc_path.parent / target.split('#')[0]).resolve().exists(), target
print(json.dumps({'review': str(review_path.relative_to(repo)), 'checks': len(checks), 'links': len(links), 'source_sha256': source_hashes, 'temporary_helpers_removed': len(helpers)}, ensure_ascii=False))
